name: Exact decoded frame assembly
operation: Select half-open decoded frame ranges and concatenate them in an explicit order without generation.

input_contract.name: source_frame_batches
input_contract.cardinality: one or more matching frame batches

input_contract.name: accepted_ranges
input_contract.cardinality: one half-open range per selected batch

output_contract.name: assembled_frames
output_contract.cardinality: sum of all accepted range lengths

graph_contract.role: select each exact half-open decoded range
concatenate selected IMAGE batches in declared order
encode or save the final visual edit
